body:
> Last year, I took this class from Kent C. Dodds.

Lucky you! I'd love to take that class. :slightly_smiling_face: 

We can also test directly the production build with the integration tests (tested it [here](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3931/commits/5d91e78f7fbfb2eda8be7bf491d3e64adb8a9111)) but we need to see how to make it works with tests running during development.

Agree for E2E tests, but it asks more efforts to be put in place so I see it more like a second step to do after the integration tests.
